page.overview:
What is Melemele Island?

Melemele Island is the first island in the Alola region, being the northwest one among the four major islands. It is where the player character starts the game. The Guardian Deity is Tapu Koko, who is found in the Ruins of Conflict.

There is only one trial on this island. The Grand Trial is with Hala, Hau's grandfather. {| class="article-table" !Name !Class !Location !Type !Totem Pokémon !Aura
